title: AbbVie to Present at the Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference
summary: AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) will participate in the Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, September 9, 2026. Management will participate in a fireside chat at 9:15 a.m. Central time....
body_markdown:
NORTH CHICAGO, Ill.


, Aug. 31, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) will participate in the Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, September 9, 2026. Management will participate in a fireside chat at 9:15 a.m. Central time.


A live audio webcast of the presentation will be accessible through AbbVie's Investor Relations website at[investors.abbvie.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4760466-1&h=2821411968&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.abbvie.com%2F&a=investors.abbvie.com) . An archived edition of the session will be available later that day.


**About AbbVie**


AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, neuroscience and oncology – and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at[www.abbvie.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4760466-1&h=1258317070&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.abbvie.com%2F&a=www.abbvie.com) .
